revisions.note: Added the data (.eeg) and marker (.vmrk) file each header names (DataFile, MarkerFile) (98 files, 3346539331 bytes); the original sourcedata snapshot held only the 49 BrainVision headers (<condition>/<participant>/*.vhdr). Source: Zenodo record 10229480 (10.5281/zenodo.10229480), members EEG_dataset/EEG/... of the archive EEG_dataset.zip. The archive's size and MD5 match the Zenodo API; members were extracted with their CRC-32 checked. Every header already in the deposit is byte-identical (SHA-256) to its member in that archive.

revisions.note: Version 2 of the release (Zenodo record 17940098, 10.5281/zenodo.17940098, 2025-12-15) adds participants AF64D, AU12D, AW98D, BR39D, BS34D, BZ29D (MOABB subjects 9-14; second study, unilateral only).
